stories.title: A New Start
paragraphs: A boy named Lee wakes up in a vast world. The sun emerged from the sky. Lee feels alone. He is in solitude.
Lee looks around. He sees trees and animals. The world is big and new. Lee knows he must be resourceful. He needs to live here.
First, Lee cuts a tree. He uses his hands. The tree falls down. Wood is an essential resource. Lee uses wood to make tools. He makes a wooden axe. This helps him cut more trees.

Next, Lee builds a shelter. The night is coming. The sky's silhouette shows the sun is setting. Night is perilous. Monsters come in the dark. Lee must have vigilance. He works fast. His shelter is small but safe.
Lee feels happy. He learns new things. He knows this world is primitive. There is no house or city here. It is just nature.
As night descended, Lee sits inside his shelter. He feels tired but safe. He is ready for tomorrow. Lee knows survival is hard. But he is strong and smart. This is his new start in Minecraft.

quiz.question: What does Lee build before night?

stories.title: Mining Adventure
paragraphs: Alex delved into a deep, dark mine. This subterranean place was full of secrets. The tunnels were labyrinthine. He needed to find diamonds.
The walls had gleaming stones. Alex moved cautiously. He did not want to fall or get lost. Suddenly, a monster tried to ambush him! Alex ran fast and hid in a crevice.
He remembered the diamonds were precious. Alex was persistent. He walked slowly and looked carefully. The mine was scary, but he did not stop.
After a long time, Alex saw a small light. It was a chest with diamonds inside! He was triumphant. Alex took the diamonds and went out of the mine.
He felt happy. The adventure was hard, but he did it. Now, he could show his friends the precious treasure.

quiz.question: What does Alex find in the chest?

stories.title: The Wisdom of the Villagers
paragraphs: One day, the player walks into a bustling village. The village is big and prosperous. Many inhabitants live here. They work and help each other.
The player sees an artisan. The artisan makes tools and weapons. The player wants to learn. So, they barter some wood for a new sword. The artisan smiles and shares his expertise.
Next, the player visits a farmer. The farmer grows food for the community. They talk about plants and animals. The player learns how to grow crops.
Suddenly, there is a commotion near the market. Two villagers try to negotiate a deal. The player watches carefully. They see how villagers trade valuable goods with respect.
The player feels happy. The village is full of life and knowledge. The player knows this place is special. Here, people share and learn from each other.
At the end of the day, the player thanks the villagers. They promise to return. The player wants to learn more and help this prosperous village grow.
The wisdom of the villagers is strong. The player feels lucky to be part of this community. They know teamwork is the best way to live and succeed.

quiz.question: What does the player trade for a sword?

stories.title: Tranquil Farm Life
paragraphs: Alex plays Minecraft. He wants to live a quiet life. He decides to build a farm.
First, Alex clears the land. He wants to cultivate the soil. He plants seeds. The seeds grow into crops. The crops are bountiful. Alex is happy.
Next, Alex builds fences. He wants to keep livestock safe. He chooses cows and chickens. He learns how to domesticate them. The animals are calm and friendly.
Alex also makes an orchard. He plants apple trees. The trees give fruit every year. Alex loves the sweet apples.
Every day, Alex works hard. He is diligent. He waters the plants and feeds the animals. The farm grows big and strong.
When the crops are ready, Alex does the harvest. He collects wheat and vegetables. He uses them to make food. The food is nourishing. It helps Alex stay healthy.
Alex thinks about the future. He wants a sustainable farm. He uses rainwater and compost. He does not waste anything.
At night, Alex sits by the farm. The farm is quiet and peaceful. He feels happy and calm. This is the tranquil life he wants.
Alex loves his farm. It is his happy place.

stories.title: The Nether Portal
paragraphs: A hero wants to make a potion. This potion needs special materials. These materials are in the Nether, a strange dimension. The hero must be brave.
The hero builds a portal. The portal is big and has a shimmering light. It looks beautiful but also ominous. The hero feels both scared and excited.
The hero steps into the portal. Suddenly, the world changes. The air is hot and searing. The sky is red and the land looks infernal.
In this unearthly place, many hostile creatures live. The hero sees monsters near a big fortress. The fortress is dark and strong.
The hero needs to find the materials for alchemy. These materials help to make the potion. The hero walks carefully and uses bravery to fight the monsters.
After many dangers, the hero finds the special plants and stones. The hero is happy but still must go back. The portal waits with shimmering light.
The hero steps through the portal. Now, the hero can make the potion. The journey to the Nether was hard but full of bravery.
The hero knows that with courage, any challenge is possible.

quiz.question: Why does the hero visit the Nether?

stories.title: The Ocean Expedition
paragraphs: Tom is a young mariner. He hears an old legend. The legend tells about a submerged monument. It is deep in the ocean abyss. Many players want to find it.
Tom wants to start an expedition. He builds a big ship. The ship is strong and can navigate on the water. Tom packs food and tools. He is ready for the journey.
The ocean is big and blue. Tom sails his ship every day. He sees many aquatic animals. Some fish are bioluminescent. They shine like stars in the dark water.
One day, Tom finds a gargantuan cave under the sea. The cave is the entrance to the monument. Tom dives into the water. He swims carefully. The water is cold but clear.
Inside the monument, Tom sees old walls and statues. The place is quiet and beautiful. Tom takes pictures and writes notes. He feels happy and proud.

After many hours, Tom returns to his ship. He sails back home. The expedition is a big success. Tom tells his friends about the legend and the monument. Everyone wants to go on an ocean expedition too.
Tom dreams about new adventures. The ocean is full of secrets. He knows he will explore again. The sea is his home.

quiz.question: What does Tom find under the sea?

stories.title: The Redstone Revolution
paragraphs: There is a smart engineer. He loves Minecraft. One day, he finds the secret of redstone. Redstone is a special stone in Minecraft. It can make power and light.
The engineer uses his ingenuity. He builds a small contraption. It moves by itself. This is the first automated machine in his world.
He studies the redstone circuitry. It is very intricate. But he learns how it works. He creates a new mechanism to open doors and move blocks.
His ideas are innovative. Many players see his machines. They like how easy and fast they work. The engineer’s work revolutionized the game. Now, players can build more machines.
He makes a machine with high efficiency. It uses less redstone and works well. The engineer plans the sequence of redstone signals carefully. This helps the machines run smoothly.
Every day, he builds new things. Some machines plant seeds. Others collect food. All are automated. The engineer’s redstone revolution changes Minecraft forever.
Players now dream of building smart machines. They remember the engineer’s ingenuity and hard work. Redstone is no longer just a stone. It is the heart of many amazing machines.

stories.title: The Legend of Herobrine
paragraphs: Tom is a lonely miner. One day, he works deep in a dark cave. Outside, thick fog covers the land. The fog is very thick and white.
Tom sees something strange. It is a white-eyed figure. This is a mythical being. Many people say it is Herobrine.
The story of Herobrine is part of Minecraft folklore. People say Herobrine is a ghost or an apparition. Some say it is a paranormal spirit. Others think it is a hoax.
Tom feels scared and curious. The fog makes the sight more eerie. He tries to get a glimpse of the figure again. But it vanished fast.
Tom thinks the figure is a sentinel watching the cave. The feeling is unnerving. He does not know if Herobrine is real or just a story.
At night, Tom dreams of the white eyes. He wants to find the truth. Is Herobrine a friend or a ghost? The legend is still a mystery.
Tom will keep mining. Maybe one day, he will see Herobrine again. Until then, the story stays alive in Minecraft folklore.

quiz.question: What happens to the strange figure?

stories.title: The Eve of the End
paragraphs: Alex finds a book with a prophecy. The prophecy tells about a pilgrimage to find the End Portal. This portal is in a stronghold deep underground. It is the threshold to a new world called the End.
Alex needs special items called Ender Eyes. These eyes are a celestial artifact. They give guidance to the stronghold. Alex collects the Ender Eyes relentlessly. He knows this is his destiny.
One day, the Ender Eyes show a convergence. It is where all paths meet. Alex feels ready. He goes to the stronghold with his friends. The journey is long and hard. But Alex never stops.
At last, they find the End Portal. Alex places the Ender Eyes in the frame. The portal opens. Light shines bright. Alex steps through the threshold. He is ready for the new adventure in the End.
Alex knows this is only the start. His pilgrimage will teach him much. The prophecy was true. His destiny is to explore the unknown. The End waits. Alex is brave. The adventure begins now.

quiz.question: What helps Alex find the stronghold?

stories.title: The Final Battle
paragraphs: The hero walks through a dark portal. He enters the End, a strange place with a void all around. The sky is black. The land is strange and quiet.
In the distance, he sees a colossal dragon. It is the Ender Dragon. The hero feels fear, but he is valiant. He knows this is the climactic moment of his adventure.
The dragon soars above the tall towers. It breathes fire and shoots purple balls. The hero runs fast. He uses his sword and bow to fight.
The battle is epic. The dragon attacks with a strong onslaught. The hero dodges and hits the dragon many times. The dragon’s health goes down.
Finally, the hero sees the dragon’s demise. The dragon falls to the ground. The hero feels joy. The End is safe now.
The hero finds a portal home. He knows he brings liberation to his world. A new era of peace will start.
The hero smiles. He is tired but happy. His adventure is over, but his story will be told forever.

quiz.question: How does the hero feel at the end?

stories.title: A Tiny Seed
paragraphs: A Tiny Seed: The Story of Wangari Maathai Nicola Rijsdijk Maya Marshak English Level
In a village on the slopes of Mount Kenya in East Africa, a little girl worked in the fields with her mother. Her name was Wangari.
Wangari loved being outside. In her family’s food garden she broke up the soil with her machete. She pressed tiny seeds into the warm earth.

Her favourite time of day was just after sunset. When it got too dark to see the plants, Wangari knew it was time to go home. She would follow the narrow paths through the fields, crossing rivers as she went.

Wangari was a clever child and couldn’t wait to go to school. But her mother and father wanted her to stay and help them at home. When she was seven years old, her big brother persuaded her parents to let her go to school.

She liked to learn! Wangari learnt more and more with every book she read. She did so well at school that she was invited to study in the United States of America. Wangari was excited! She wanted to know more about the world.

At the American university Wangari learnt many new things. She studied plants and how they grow. And she remembered how she grew: playing games with her brothers in the shade of the trees in the beautiful Kenyan forests.
The more she learnt, the more she realised that she loved the people of Kenya. She wanted them to be happy and free. The more she learnt, the more she remembered her African home.

When she had finished her studies, she returned to Kenya. But her country had changed. Huge farms stretched across the land. Women had no wood to make cooking fires. The people were poor and the children were hungry.

Wangari knew what to do. She taught the women how to plant trees from seeds. The women sold the trees and used the money to look after their families. The women were very happy. Wangari had helped them to feel powerful and strong.
As time passed, the new trees grew into forests, and the rivers started flowing again. Wangari’s message spread across Africa. Today, millions of trees have grown from Wangari’s seeds.
Wangari had worked hard. People all over the world took notice, and gave her a famous prize. It is called the Nobel Peace Prize, and she was the first African woman ever to receive it.
Wangari died in 2011, but we can think of her every time we see a beautiful tree.
